name: ch22-shap
caption: SHAP weights of the honest model, coloured by the direction of each feature's effect.
live:
import io
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DATA = """feature,mean_abs_shap,direction,corr_value_shap,weight
n_cafe_500m,0.20165,higher value -> more suitable,0.70562,0.46383
dist_tourism,0.054395,higher value -> less suitable,-0.76815,0.12512
population,0.049291,higher value -> more suitable,0.73283,0.11338
n_tourism_500m,0.04487,higher value -> more suitable,0.62098,0.10321
dist_road,0.028699,higher value -> less suitable,-0.64594,0.066011
n_education_500m,0.028488,higher value -> more suitable,0.49105,0.065526
dist_education,0.027359,higher value -> more suitable,0.35196,0.06293
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(DATA))

def plot_shap(df):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.8, 3.4))
    cols = ["#1a9850" if r > 0.1 else "#d73027" if r < -0.1 else "#9aa5b1"
            for r in df.corr_value_shap]
    ax.barh(df.feature[::-1], df.weight[::-1], color=cols[::-1])
    ax.set_xlabel("Weight (share of mean |SHAP|)")
    ax.set_title("What the model used (green: more is better; red: less is better)",
                 loc="left", fontsize=9)
    return fig

plot_shap(df)
plt.show()
